oneLine: OYO parent reduces IPO size to revive listing plans

sources.title: OYO Parent Prism Nearly Halves IPO Size to Revive Long-Delayed Listing

synopsis: Prism, the parent company of budget hotel operator OYO, has reduced its proposed initial public offering size to raise 3,350 crore rupees through a fresh share issue, down from its earlier 6,650 crore rupee proposal. SoftBank-backed Prism is seeking to advance its long-pending stock market debut after several delays since its first filing in 2021. The revised fundraising target involves a fresh issue of shares, providing funds directly to the company. The article does not name any individual selling shareholders, specific advisers, or a finalized listing date.
